Interface GameSession

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractGameSession, PracticeSession
public interface GameSession
Unified contract for all game sessions.

The UI layer and Main depend only on this interface. Whether the underlying session is a PracticeSession or

invalid reference 
BattleSession
is irrelevant to the caller — they drive the session through this API alone.

Lifecycle

  1. Obtain an instance from GameSessionFactory.
  2. Poll getCurrentLetter() to know what to show.
  3. Call attempt(List) with each camera frame's landmarks.
  4. Repeat until isFinished() returns true.
  5. Call finish() to retrieve the GameResult.

    • attempt

      AttemptRecord attempt(List<HandLandmark> userLandmarks)
      Submits a recognition attempt using the given hand landmarks.

      In practice mode, this is called for the single player. In battle mode, the playerId is resolved internally; for a multi-player UI that drives each player separately use

      invalid reference 
      BattleSession#submitAttempt(String, List)
      directly.
      Parameters:
      userLandmarks - 21 hand landmarks from the live camera feed
      Returns:
      the AttemptRecord created for this attempt
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the session is already finished

    • getTotalScore
